title: Present the safe admin audit projection

gates.name: admin_audit_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/admin-audit.spec.ts

verify: Independent Boss/non-Boss browser verification covers safe audit fields, filters, stable cursor continuation, no-store, and absence of presentation-origin writes.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-016 RED: no Boss browser surface reads admin audit; GREEN: exact safe filtered pages render with complete cursor continuation while non-Boss access fails and page interaction emits no audit/domain mutation; decisive comparison: protected response versus DOM, request transcript, and audit-row count; artifact: admin-audit evidence under .tasks/TASK-099-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the admin audit read result independently of the mutations that produce its records.
success_outcome: A Boss can traverse the safe admin audit projection while non-Boss users are denied and presentation creates no audit or mutable-domain record.
anti_goals: Do not implement Account/role/Plant/grant mutations or create client-authored audit records.
Do not expose passwords, auth/session material, raw database errors, or provider data.

stop_conditions: The read needs fields outside the Boss Admin audit contract.
Safe pagination cannot avoid exposing protected/raw backend data.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Access & Admin owns audit persistence/query.
Render exact safe summaries and treat the cursor as opaque.
invariants: Audit presentation is read-only and cannot become agent context or domain authority.
Non-Boss users cannot enumerate audit records.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-016: exact safe admin audit fields/filters/pagination, non-Boss denial, and zero presentation-origin write.
T3 harm proof uses isolated audit rows and proves denied/malformed reads leave no record or secret residue.
